meta.name: geo-content-optimizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "optimize for AI citations"; improves citation readiness for ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude. Not for structural on-page SEO — use on-page-seo-auditor; not for net-new drafting — use seo-content-writer. AI引用优化/GEO优化/AI搜索

copy.tagline: 优化内容以提升AI搜索引用率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望内容在ChatGPT等AI搜索中被优先引用
copy.tagline_en: Optimize content for better AI citation rates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your content to be cited by AI search engines like ChatGPT

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的内容，添加清晰定义、可引用语句、数据来源和问答格式，使其更可能被 ChatGPT、Perplexity、AI Overviews 等 AI 引擎引用。
howto.when: 当你要求“优化 AI 引用”或“GEO 优化”，或提供内容 URL 或文本时触发。

say.text: 优化这段内容，让它更容易被 AI 引用。
say.note: Claude 会分析并改进内容结构。

say.text: 检查这篇文章的 GEO 就绪度并提出改进建议。
say.note: Claude 会生成评分和修改清单。

say.text: 为这个主题写一段同时适合 SEO 和 GEO 的内容。
say.note: Claude 会产出优化后的文本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your content, adds clear definitions, quotable statements, data sources, and Q&A formatting to make it more likely to be cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'optimize for AI citations' or 'GEO optimization', or provide a content URL or text.

say_en.text: Optimize this content to be more AI-citable.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and improve structure.

say_en.text: Audit this article for GEO readiness and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a score and checklist.

say_en.text: Write content about this topic optimized for both SEO and GEO.
